_documentTypesComment: Mongolia's document-type registry. These entries MUST reproduce the labels and colors that were previously hardcoded in src/lib/utils.ts (DOC_LABELS/DOC_COLORS/DOC_MEDIUM_LABELS/DOC_FULL_LABELS) verbatim so Mongolia's dashboard display is unchanged after the open-PolicyDocumentType migration. BTR and OTHER are reserved tokens with universal fallbacks in src/lib/utils.ts but are declared here explicitly for clarity. Order: anchor (Vision 2050) first; BTR last among country-declared docs (OTHER catch-all comes after).
_documentMetaComment: Reference metadata (docKind / published / author / url / objective) for the doc-focus panel; every url verified to return HTTP 200 on 2026-06-30 by reading the document's cover/front matter. Sources: Vision 2050 on cabinet.gov.mn; NDC (v2, approved by Government Decree 407 of Nov 2019), NAP and BTR1 on unfccc.int; NBSAP (the 2015 National Biodiversity Program, CBD; English is an unofficial translation) on cbd.int; FSS = State Great Hural Resolution 36 of 17 Jun 2022 on legalinfo.mn (Mongolian only, no official English version); NRVTS and ILDN on unccd.int. Objectives for Vision 2050 and the NDC are verbatim from those documents. ILDN's cover carries no date (UNCCD repository folder dated Feb 2019) so its published is omitted. BER (internal expenditure review) and OTHER (catch-all) have no public single-document source, so no metadata is set. A newer Mongolia NDC 3.0 (2025) exists, but the analysed targets are from the 2019 NDC.
